class.name: NetwQuantizeFixed
class.brief_description: [NetwQuantize] that snaps a value to a fixed-point grid over a bounded range.
class.description: A value is rounded to the nearest [member resolution_step] within [member min_limit]..[member max_limit] and packed in just enough bits to address the grid. [Vector3] or [Vector2] quantizes each axis the same way. Best for world positions (e.g. [code]position[/code] with [code]resolution_step = 0.5[/code]). [codeblock] var q := NetwQuantizeFixed.new().step(0.5).limits(-2048.0, 2048.0) [/codeblock] A value on the grid round-trips exactly, so a game that authors positions in multiples of its step pays no quantization error at all. The per-axis error is at most half [member resolution_step].

method.name: limits
method.description: Builder that sets [member min_limit] and [member max_limit] and returns this quantizer.

method.name: step
method.description: Builder that sets [member resolution_step] and returns this quantizer.
